answer: Sybil resistance works best as an escalating admission bond: every new identity arriving at the shared harbor must lock a refundable deposit that rises super-linearly with how many keys already trace to its funding source. One honest newcomer pays a single plank; a swarm of clones stacks timber ever higher, paying a steep sum per head. Random peer panels sample liveness, and one missed check slashes the whole bond, so a faked crowd that musters only a faint whisper of real work stays strictly loss-making.
